| #### Combat Coordinated / Will Amp / You move as a team, with your team. / Coordinated Start. As part of rolling initiative, you gain a rank of Mastery to your initiative. This becomes 2 ranks at 7th and 3 ranks at 15th level. / Team Coordination. You can select a willing allies creature to go in your place in initiative. This counts as their turn for initiative. If you take another Combat Coordinated creatures place in initiative, you must give your place in initiative to another Combat Coordinated creature. / Coordinated Support. If another Combat Coordinated creature is under the effect of a condition or hostile effect that requires an ability or skill check, or a saving throw, you can spend your reaction to make that check or saving throw for them using your statistics. |

3rd Level Clan Feature

You don’t react. You knew what was going to happen hours ago, and you planned a contingency for it immediately afterwards.

At the beginning of each of your turns, you can spend your Bonus Action to establish a Contingency. A Contingency is combination of a Cause (Trigger) and an Effect (Result). This increases to two Contingencies as part of the same bonus action at 11th level.

When you do, select one Cause(trigger) and then one Effect(result), which form a single Contingency. A Contingency is prepared until the beginning of your next turn. If a Cause occurs within this duration, then the Effect is applied at the same time as the Cause occurring.

Cause

An allied creature is targeted by an attack.

| #### Diplomatic Coordination / Social Amp / You move as a team, with your team. / Coordinated Words. You gain a rank of Mastery to either Deception, Persuasion or Intimidation (pick one) for the remainder of this social encounter. This becomes 2 ranks at 7th and 3 ranks at 15th level. / Coordinated Experience. If your Background is related to or associated with the opposing creature, you gain advantage on Insight checks. |

An allied creature fails a saving throws.

An allied creature gains a Physical Condition.

An allied creature gains a Mental Condition.

A hostile creature you can see casts a jutsu with a Hand Sign (HS) component.

A hostile creature that you can see, begins their turn concentrating on a jutsu.

A hostile creature you can see moves within 10 feet of an allied creature.

Effect

Grant an allied creature a rank of mastery to their AC, until the beginning of their next turn.

Grant an allied creature a rank of mastery to their saving throws, until the beginning of their next turn.

An allied creature can remake their saving throw for any effect currently applied to them.

An allied creature makes an opportunity attack against a hostile creature they can see within their range at no reaction cost.

An allied creature spends their reaction to move up to 10 feet without triggering attacks of opportunities. If this movement takes them out of range of an area effect, they are no longer a target and if they move out of range of a hostile creatures attack, the hostile creature must choose a new valid target.

An allied creature spends their reaction to cast a jutsu with a casting time of 1 Action against a hostile creature in its range.
